content:
sam_sales: Heads up 1: new POC with MediNova. They want: HSM-backed keys, explicit subproc consent in DPA, Dedicated test capacity, and Net45. Can legal + procurement confirm if we can sign this week?
rita_legal: Need the customer's redline text. Quick checks: Net45 ok from a billing perspective? subproc prior-consent is a heavy ask.
owen_procure: Net45 increases credit risk; finance will want a backup (prepay or PO with GL). If Dedicated, we usually require a minimum monthly commitment on the order form to issue a PO.
tara_se: Technical note 1: HSM integration depends on whether customer manages the HSM or we host. If customer-managed, we need certs and rotation docs. If we host HSM in their VPC we need cross-account IAM and a network playbook.
sam_sales: Copy redlines here:
```
MSA: Section 5.1 - Indemnity broadened to include privacy claims without cap
DPA: Section 3 - Customer requires written consent for any subprocessor plus full list in appendix
Order Form: Add monthly-minimum USD 8,000 for Dedicated test node
Billing: Net45 invoicing, remit to billing@medinova.org
Signature: Two signers required (Legal + Finance), prefer DocuSign with in-person notarization clause struck
```
rita_legal: Privacy indemnity uncapped 1 is a showstopper. We'll propose retaining $1M cap and an explicit carveout for IP and security breaches. On subprocessors, we can provide current list + 30 days' notice, but not prior written consent for every add.
owen_procure: If order form includes $8k monthly minimum and they still want Net45, finance will accept a PO referencing the order form but requests a 50% upfront on first month.
tara_se: For onboarding1: need SOC2 (latest), network CIDR + ASN, and KMS attestation. I can prepare a 1-page attestation for DocuSign attachment with config example: 
```
mode: customer-managed
required: csr, attestation-report, rotation-schedule
rotation: 180d
```
docusign-bot: DocuSign draft created: https://docusign.example/envelope/zz9y8x7 (status: draft) — will send when legal confirms signers and attachments.
sam_sales: @rita_legal can you draft the counter with: (1) $1M cap, (2) subproc list + 30-day notice, (3) remove uncapped privacy indemnity, and (4) accept PO w/ 50% upfront if Dedicated?
rita_legal: Yes. Also note: remove notarization requirement 1: DocuSign + two signers is fine. I'll add exec-approval gate if they maintain uncapped privacy indemnity.
owen_procure: I'll prep a PO template that references the order form ID and includes 50% upfront for first invoice. Also flag any tax withholding requirements for their jurisdiction.
tara_se: I'll draft KMS attestation now and post here; need to confirm whether we're provisioning HSM or they're providing.
sam_sales: MediNova billing contact is finance@medinova.org. Target to get countersigned before Friday EOD. Thanks team.
rita_legal: Draft counter by 1800 PT. If they refuse privacy cap, escalate.
owen_procure: PO template ready by EOD.
docusign-bot: Envelope updated with attachments (attestation, SOC2 placeholder) at https://docusign.example/envelope/zz9y8x7 (status: ready)
sam_sales: I'll follow up with MediNova tonight and push for signature. Keep thread for final envelope link and PO number.
